description: The Format-2 in-place table SORT - a 2002 introduction, recognized syntactically (a SORT with neither USING/GIVING nor INPUT/OUTPUT procedures is the F2 shape). Folded from the inline SortBinder gate (Exec Step E).
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.40.3 SR13 (Format 2 - the in-place table sort; COBOL-85 SORT operates on sort-merge files only)
source:
